✅ Approved the contribution.
Comment: Perfect for a clash of code

Formatting / presentation
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format your statement properly as described in the points below (some already mentioned by @LDdevv):

Goal
* Please format all instances of "n" and "k" as [[variables]].

* Please format all instances of "8" as {{constants}}.

Input
* Please format "Line 1" and "Line 2" in <<bold>>.

* Please format "n" and "k" as [[variables]].

Constraints
* Please format "n" and "k" as [[variables]].

Cases
* Please remove the trailing newlines from the input for:
  • Basic Encryption (Test 1)
  • Complementary Bits (Test 5)

* Each test and its corresponding validator should cover the *same scenario*, but use *different inputs* when possible. Currently, all the cases have different names, which makes it seem like each test/validator pair is covering a different scenario. If that's the case, please expand each case into a pair of cases to cover the same scenario as described.

* Please add a pair of new cases where n = 0 and k ≠ 0.

Thanks.

Statement:
Format [[n]] and [[k]] as [[variables]].
Goal:
This is just for clarity, but change this:
"1. XOR n with k." to "1. Compare the bits of [[n]] and [[k]] using the <<XOR>> logic gate."
You should change "print" to "output".
Output:
Not really necessary, but put "Line 1:" at the start.
Everything else i don't know because I haven't solved this yet

Thanks for the review! I’ve applied your suggestions:

* Formatted all instances of n and k as variables using [[n]] and [[k]].
* Changed XOR n with k to Compare the bits of [[n]] and [[k]] using the <<XOR>> logic gate.
* Changed Print to Output in the Goal.
* Added <<Line 1:>> to the Output section.

Thanks for the feedback!

Thanks for the detailed review! I’ve applied the requested changes:

- Formatted all instances of n and k as [[variables]].
- Formatted all instances of 8 as {{constants}}.
- Formatted Line 1 and Line 2 in bold in the Input section.
- Removed the trailing newlines from Basic Encryption and Complementary Bits.
- Updated the test/validator pairs so that each pair covers the same scenario with different inputs and uses the same name.
- Added a new test/validator pair where n = 0 and k ≠ 0.

Thanks again for the review!
